svg.title: British Columbia arms — 1960 Museum report engraving, constructed vector
svg.desc: Independent manual reconstruction of the small engraving on the 1960 Provincial Museum annual report, printed in 1961. Fine anatomy and engraving are interpreted where the original 208 by 174 ink pixels do not resolve them. Not an authenticated printing master. Curved flame rays and an uninterrupted sun face replace conjectural triangles and an unsupported internal semicircle. Revised 2026-11-21 using the clearer title-page impression in Internet Archive report1960brit: corrected scalloped crown and central cross pattee, horn-core cuts, lion/stag/ram engraving, fold hatching, and removal of unsupported motto serifs. Fine engraving remains interpretive.
svg.metadata: {"source": "https://rbcm.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/annual_report_1960.pdf#page=1", "method": "manual cubic Bezier and engraving construction; no automatic tracing", "native_crop": [1130, 1550, 1360, 1755], "source_image_size": [230, 205], "date_note": "Report for 1960, printed1961; drawing dateunknown", "status": "reconstruction; fine details interpreted"}
